test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per Union Budget 2025–26, how much corpus has been allocated to the Ministry of Science and Technology to finance private-sector-led research, development, and innovation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹20,000 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **Union Budget 2025–26**, the Government of India announced a significant allocation of **₹20,000 crore** to the **Ministry of Science and Technology**.
 
• The primary purpose of this corpus is to **finance private-sector-led research, development (R&D), and innovation** on a commercial scale.
 
• This funding mechanism is designed to provide **long-term financing or refinancing** with long tenors and low or nil interest rates, encouraging the private sector to increase its R&D expenditure.
 
• The initiative is closely aligned with the **Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)** framework, which aims to provide strategic direction to scientific research in the country.
 
• The allocation reflects the government's shift toward fostering a **collaborative ecosystem** where the private sector takes a leading role
